evidence: Agent-visible surface = task/instruction.md + environment/instructions/{conversations,integration,walls-and-retention}.md + environment/assets/seed_data.json + environment/Dockerfile (COPY instructions/ and assets/ only; tests/ is not copied). Skill grep from quality-checks.md:26 (judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel), extended with probe|gate|grader|verif|oracle|harbor|polish|visual|functional|render|constraint|mcp|checker|score: zero hits across instruction.md, all three notes and the env Dockerfile; seed_data.json hits only kittle.test emails. Criterion ids (24 across gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual judge.toml): none appear as ids; only incidental natural-language matches 'Search and transcripts' heading (walls-and-retention.md:31) and 'the hold mark' (walls-and-retention.md:35), which are product requirements, not identifiers. Dimension names/weights (scoring.toml functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2, floors) are absent from the public text. Probe literals: functional judge.toml creates JUDGE-prefixed messages (JUDGE, JUDGE-CS1, JUDGE-D1, JUDGE-E1, JUDGE-F1, JUDGE-H ...); 'JUDGE' appears nowhere in the brief, notes or seed (case-insensitive grep), so the agent cannot special-case grader-created content. Of 183 quoted/ID literals extracted from all judge.toml files, those found in public text are only product labels the brief itself mandates ('On hold', 'edited', 'new messages', 'not available', 'M-12'); others matched only seed fixture text (pre-existing data the judge reads, not grader sentinels; pre-satisfaction is row 36's concern). Verbatim overlap (8-word shingles, public text vs every tests/ text file): only 'shows a short preview of the linked message' in functional judge.toml (criterion restating the public requirement at conversations.md:17) and the account table in app_context.md (accounts are a public input per staged-task-contract.md:177). No criterion text copied into the brief. task.toml description says 'browser-judged' (line 6) but task.toml is task metadata, not agent-facing prompt text. Counterexample search: a broken app could exploit a leak only if the brief exposed probe prefixes, criterion order or judge routes; none are exposed, so no such app is enabled by the prompt. A conforming alternative cannot fail this row (it is a source-text property). This row is a source-only check; no runtime evidence is required for it, and no Oracle/model/portal score is claimed.
